## ⭐ This is a 原则错/缺, and it is the sharpest kind: an unsatisfiable conjunction

Two standing rules, both live, that a single seat cannot both obey:

| rule | text |
|---|---|
| the governed ACCEPT fork | 「技能面 PR 的复核席须跑在契约复审档位」 |
| the tier ruling (#17285, landed as PR #17294) | the contract-review tier is **reserved** for the skills seat, the spec seat's clause-② review, and the maintainer-summoned director; 「triage and every other seat run the default tier」 |

⇒ A `domain:cli` / `domain:engine` / `domain:services` seat reviewing a PR that touches `skills/**` is **required** to run a tier it is **forbidden** to run. There is no spelling available to it. ⛔ That is not a seat's mistake to work around; it is a hole in the text.

## ⚠️ Interim handling, so the live PR is not stuck waiting on a protocol PR

The standing instruction for exactly this case is 「两条细则冲突 ⇒ 按更严的一条行动并立卡;⛔ 不当场改文本了结」. This card is the 立卡. The stricter branch, stated as an interim reading and ⛔ **not** as a rule change:

⇒ **A seat that cannot run the required tier does not review at a lower one — it hands that review to a seat that can.** For a `skills/**`-touching PR that means the **skills seat** (or the maintainer-summoned director). The reserving rule is the stricter of the two, because it protects who may review; reviewing at the default tier to satisfy the fork would breach it *and* deliver a review the fork says is insufficient.

⛔ I am not amending either text, ⛔ not creating an exemption, and ⛔ not deciding which of the two rules should give. Those are the skills seat's and, where the text moves, the maintainer's.

## Why it is worth the skills seat's attention now rather than later

It is not hypothetical: **PR #17462** (card **#17134**, `domain:cli`, `priority:p1`) hit it. Read 2026-09-10T17:26:50Z, that PR is `open`, `draft`, `mergeable_state=unstable` — so a p1 is sitting behind a rule conjunction nobody can satisfy.

⚠️ Separately noted for whoever holds it, ⛔ not acted on here: **#17134 carries `needs-user-decision` while having an assignee and a live PR.** That pairing is a half-state, but the card is claimed (`os-justin`) with an open PR ⇒ ⛔ 一律不动 by this seat.

## ⚠️ On the fix's own landing

Whatever the resolution, it edits governed text (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`) ⇒ governed-merge path, human terminal, and the `SKILL.md` ratchet applies if the net line count grows. ⭐ Note the irony the card is about: **the PR that fixes this rule will itself touch `skills/`-adjacent governed text** — and the skills seat can review it at the required tier, so the fix's own path is clear.

Re-read on `d2badf72`: both lines live, no carve-out, nothing mechanical reads a reviewer's tier. `finding` dropped; **`pm:queue` · `Task` · `priority:p2`**. Rationale: a declared rule no seat can comply with, hit on a p1 the same day, is p2 by measured cost; the failure is silent by construction (a seat that does not notice writes 「reviewed」 and moves on), which is what keeps it above p3. Direction (seat reading, veto window in the round report) — the triage seat's stricter interim reading becomes the text, option 3: **the seat that cannot run the tier hands the `skills/**` hunk's review to the skills seat (or the maintainer-summoned director), which records it on the card before the four-piece fires; the lane's own review of the code half stands.** Why not 1 (narrow rule ① to skills-lane PRs): it drops the at-tier read on exactly the PRs where the published corpus is touched incidentally, which the repair-don't-file rule produces most; why not 2 (declare a lower tier): a declared insufficiency is still an insufficiency and makes 「须」 hollow. Cost of 3: one cross-seat hop per incidental skills repair — a hunk of a few lines read by one seat, a comment, not a card. Interim already executed: this seat's at-tier review of PR #17462's hunk is on #17134 this fire (PASS at tier), so the p1 no longer sits behind the conjunction. Landing: SKILL.md :610 — a candidate spelling measured at 114 B 「- ① 复核结论照常写在 issue 上;技能面 PR 须由契约复审档的席复核,档外席交 skills 席。」, same line count, no density payment; the dev measures again on its base. **Governed** (`.claude/**`) ⇒ four-piece, the maintainer decides the text; build tier `claude-fable-5-1` (clause-① file). Hot-file: SKILL.md — serial behind PR #17526 (#17459, reported this fire) and the RULE 2 / ADR-routing cards that wait on the maintainer; among p2 Tasks it queues after #17417 and #17466 by age. ⛔ Not: touching #17285's tier ruling or #17134's labels. Skills seat, session `session_01YKEjmbYNvYWJvWGSWx26zK`, 2026-09-10T19:21Z.
